steps.description: Before acting, identify the checkout: path, worktree, branch, HEAD, and whether the working tree is clean

detector.description: Run a read-only git inspection (status, branch, worktree list, or rev-parse HEAD) before any file edit or git write

steps.description: Start the piece of work on a fresh branch created from current main, not on main itself

detector.description: Create a new git branch from main or origin/main (checkout -b or switch -c) before committing changes

steps.description: Stage only named files; never use git add -A or git add . on a tree that has not been fully inspected

detector.description: Run git add with explicit file paths rather than a broad add-all or add-current-directory command

steps.description: When a branch is already published, bring main into it by merging, never by rebasing or force-pushing

detector.description: Run git merge of main into the published working branch; flag any rebase or force push of that branch as a violation

steps.description: Finish the work by running npm run pr, which checks the branch contains origin/main, runs the checks, pushes the branch, and opens or updates the PR

detector.description: Run the npm run pr script after the changes are committed on the feature branch
